utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Alright, so we start at 10 and break at noon when the truck arrives. I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Eli. I'll bring my tool belt and the extra hammers.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, I'll have my own tools sorted and ready by 9:45 so we're not wasting any time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! I think I have some old tools in my garage. Do we need those?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, Oren! Tools are always welcome—Vik's already bringing a blender and a lamp, so every bit helps.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, I'll go dig through my garage! Wait, was it Saturday or Sunday? I keep mixing it up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, are we talking about the old water pump or the fence? I want to be sure we're on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Hana, I'm really hoping we have a list of everything folks are bringing—I don't want us to end up with too many hammers and no nails.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I hear you about the list, but I'm still not sure—are we talking about the water pump repair drive or the fence?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, Gus, that's great! I was just about to ask if anyone knew more about the repair drive. What exactly are they fixing up at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, Nell, I've been telling everyone about it! It's this Saturday morning — we're fixing up old furniture, electronics, and clothes, so bring anything you've got that needs a little love.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that sounds wonderful, Mara! I've got an old lamp that's been gathering dust—maybe I'll bring that along.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, that's good. So we're all set for Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Almost—just waiting on a couple of small parts, but it should be ready by Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, so Saturday's a go then. I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, hey Quinn! I've actually been tallying up what neighbors are offering—looks like we've got a good start on tools, but I'm still hoping for more duct tape to fill the gap.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great to hear, Cleo! I'll ask around—I bet the Johnsons have a stash of duct tape they've been hoarding.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That'd be amazing, Quinn! I'll check my own garage too—pretty sure I've got a couple rolls buried somewhere.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, yes, Dane! I'm so glad it's been moved to Sunday at the community center — more space and more time for everyone to bring their items.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, Sunday at the community center works much better for me. Thanks for the update, Rosa.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course, Dane! I'll make sure to have a sign-up sheet ready so we can keep everything organized.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey everyone! Vik, I'll help you with that lawnmower for sure. Dane, we're just getting started—bring whatever you've got that needs fixing!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks Sam! I'm planning to bring my old lawnmower, and maybe that broken blender too for Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds great, Vik! I'll grab my tools so we can take a look at both of those.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey, Uli—did you hear the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I heard. Sunday works better for me anyway—I can finally bring that old toaster I've been meaning to fix.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, so you're still bringing the toaster? Need me to clear a spot for it at the sign-in table?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh yes, I'll be there! I've got a list of everyone's items and a map of where to set up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds great, Opal. I can help you organize the list if you want.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That would be wonderful, Rey! I've already color-coded the items by type and marked the best spots on the map for each station.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, Hana, it's for the garden's water pump. Leo, how about I ask around the school for some strong volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Alright, bring them by Saturday morning. I'll show them what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I'll put up a notice and see if any parents or older students can help out on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are you sure that repair drive is actually going to fix the problem, or are we just wasting our time?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh honey, it's at the community center on Sunday now—they've got real handy folks there, so I'm betting my old toaster will be saved!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, but how do you know those folks aren't just hobbyists? I've seen these things go sideways before.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Gus, I'm checking inventory for the repair drive—you got any spare tools or duct tape we could use?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I've got a bunch of tools in the shed—screwdrivers, wrenches, and plenty of duct tape. I can bring them over Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That's perfect, Gus—Saturday morning works for me. I'll add you to the list of contributors.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Leo, you hear anything new about the repair drive? I've been asking around but no one's given me a straight answer yet.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Oh right, Mara told me about it. Said my old tools could be useful. Still don't know what's actually being fixed, though.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, that's what I keep hearing—everyone's bringing stuff but no one knows what for. Oren found his old wrenches, Vik is bringing a lawnmower, but still no word on the actual project.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It's coming along nicely, Faye. We'll be set up in the community center parking lot from 10 to 4 on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect! I can put together a sign-up sheet for parents to bring snacks and drinks for the volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great idea, Faye. I'll make sure we have tables and extension cords ready for all the items people are bringing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Mina, did you hear the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center? That gives us more time to dig out our broken stuff!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah, I heard. You got anything specific you're bringing, or just browsing?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I've got an old lamp that's been gathering dust—maybe they can work their magic on it! What about you?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can do that. Tools need to be in the right place for people to fix things properly.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That's exactly what we need! I'll make sure you have a list of what's coming in, but you can just sort as you see fit.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good. I'll keep things tidy so everyone can find what they need.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh hey Oren, I'm just catching up myself — did you hear the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh! I thought it was Saturday at my porch. Lucky you told me — I'd have been out there waiting with a rusty wrench.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, it changed last minute — sorry you almost got stuck waiting! At least now it's indoors if it rains.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Noah, I just heard about the repair drive from Mrs. Gable—sounds like they're fixing the community center and the park gate too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Repair drive? Oh right, that thing. Wait—are we supposed to bring stuff or just show up?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I think we're supposed to bring tools if we have them, but just showing up to help works too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh hey, yeah, I think I'll bring that old toolbox—Saturday morning, right?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are you sure that repair drive is actually going to fix the problem, or are we just wasting our time?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, I mean, it's got to be better than nothing, right? I'm just bringing my toolbox and hoping for the best.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it, so the repair drive covers the fence too. I'll make sure we have those measuring tools ready.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I already picked up the repair drive from Alex, so we're all set for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Good, so we have the drive itself. Let's double-check the measuring tools are in the kit.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara, have you heard about the repair drive next Saturday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, I'm actually helping organize it! We're asking neighbors to bring in old tools and broken items to fix up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That's great! Vik from down the street mentioned he's bringing his old blender and a broken lamp. Is there anything specific you're hoping to get fixed?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: The repair drive is now Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Sunday at the community center? Do we have a list of what everyone's bringing? I don't want us to end up with six hammers and no nails.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I don't have a list... I was just told about the change. Maybe we can start one?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh actually Vik, I need to let you know — the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday. I hope that still works for you!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, thanks Rosa! I'll still bring my old blender and broken lamp, just on Sunday instead. See you there!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's perfect, Vik! I'll make a note that you're bringing the lawnmower, blender, and lamp — see you Sunday at the community center!
